subject.title: feat(slack): render native charts from portable presentations

question: Should OpenClaw accept `chart` as a new portable presentation block and plugin SDK contract now, or keep chart rendering outside the shared presentation API for this release?
rationale: This is not just a Slack renderer patch; it expands the public plugin/message presentation contract and affects sibling channel fallback behavior, which needs maintainer API direction.

options.title: Accept Portable Chart Primitive
options.body: Approve the shared chart block direction, then require live Slack proof, exact-head CI, and changelog cleanup before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Slack-Local Support
options.body: Keep Slack native chart rendering private to Slack-specific `channelData.slack.blocks` or another Slack-owned path until a broader presentation API is designed.

options.title: Defer To Rich Output Umbrella
options.body: Pause or close this PR and continue the chart/reporting API decision on the broader Slack Block Kit issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Portable Chart Primitive
recommendation.body: Approve the shared chart block direction, then require live Slack proof, exact-head CI, and changelog cleanup before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored much of the existing presentation API history and authored this proposed extension to that contract.
